answer: Anchor every agent identity to one stake: one wallet, one locked deposit, and every action draws its cost from that deposit. Influence is priced quadratically, so the first vote costs 1 token, the tenth costs 100, and buying a thousand voices costs a million. Each action is signed by a cipher tied to the stake. Splitting the stake across fakes leaves each too weak to matter, while one big stake is visible and slashable. Forging 10,000 fake identities burns 1,000,000 POA and 30 days of setup. Like a willow, an honest economy bends but never breaks. - Jowy
